root_idea.summary: The root denotes aiding or supporting through a gift or other means.
root_idea.development: The basic orientation is assistance rendered by giving or strengthening. From this develop gifts and aid, mutual assistance, acquisition from another, supporting implements, tributary streams, and abundant provision.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed as the normalized passive participial form مَرْفُودٌ.
Displayed under the normalized noun citation form رِفْدٌ.

senses.definition: Bestowed or given as a gift.
senses.usage_conditions: In the expression بِئْسَ الرِّفْدُ الْمَرْفُودُ (Quran 11:99), it describes the gift or benefaction that is bestowed.
In بِئْسَ الرِّفْدُ الْمَرْفُودُ (Quran 11:99), it denotes the gift or benefaction being bestowed; the broader Classical use for aid is listed separately.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone a gift.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I verb; the object receives a gift or benefaction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To aid, help, or assist someone, by a gift, words, or another means.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I verb; assistance may be rendered with or without a material gift.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prop up or support one thing with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of supporting a wall or another object with a prop.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fit or furnish something with a supporting appurtenance, pad, or compress.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of putting a saddle appurtenance on a camel or furnishing a wound with a piece of cloth as a compress.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hold one thing fast to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive construction describing one thing securing another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone a lord or chief, magnify or honor him, and place him over affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form II, with a figurative or social elevation associated with a chief's gift-giving.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go at a brisk pace resembling a quick measured gait.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate Form II usage describing manner of walking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To aid or assist one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VI reciprocal usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To gain, acquire, or earn property, or to obtain a gift or aid from someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VIII usage focused on acquiring or receiving benefit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek, desire, demand, or ask someone for aid or assistance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form X; the requested assistance may be by a gift or otherwise.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Aid, help, or assistance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Assistance may be provided by a gift, milk, words, or anything else.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lot, share, or portion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use distinct from the senses of gift and assistance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large drinking cup or bowl, or a vessel in which one milks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may denote a large vessel used for serving drink or milking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the idiom هُرِيقَ رِفْدُهُ, to be slain or to die.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic, figurative use based on the emptying of the vessel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A company or group of men aiding one another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective noun for a mutually supportive group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel whose abundant milk fills the large milking vessel in one milking or supplies milk continuously.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a camel noted for abundant or uninterrupted milk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A supporting pad beneath a saddle, or a piece of material used as a wound compress.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete support or furnishing placed beneath a saddle or against a wound.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A communal contribution used to provide food and drink for pilgrims.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers especially to the pre-Islamic Qurashī provision for pilgrims, collected according to each contributor's means.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An excellent aider, helper, or assistant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative personal designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who gives gifts or provides aid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Active participle; it can also be used figuratively of hands or arms that afford aid or succor.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One next in station to a king who aids him and occupies his place in his absence.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A political or courtly designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A river that flows into and augments another river; a tributary.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In the dual الرَّافِدَانِ, it is an appellation for the Tigris and Euphrates.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing that aids, helps, or supports.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine noun of the pattern فَاعِلَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rafter, beam, or timber of a roof.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Usually used in the plural رَوَافِدُ for the roof timbers supporting the structure above.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A class or surname of Abyssinians mentioned in traditional reports.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper-name or ethnonymic use, with أَرْفِدَةَ also reported as a variant.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The buttocks or posterior parts of a woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive anatomical use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pad or stuffed piece used to make a woman's small buttocks appear larger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete padding or prosthetic support.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Ewes or she-goats whose milk does not cease in summer or winter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural term for animals with continuous milk production.
